entities.how_described: 本集把品味比作「说不」的肌肉：Evan 否决过的点子比多数消费级公司上线的产品都好；产品领导者应是博物馆策展人，面试可问「你做过但从未发布的东西」来检验；AI 极不擅长做减法，砍东西的责任落在产品团队头上。

evidence.quote: Exercising that kind of muscle of saying no of restraint is probably one of the few muscles of taste you can exercise.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_1

evidence.quote: And I think the thing about product, especially when it comes to consumer and anything that involves more creativity and taste, is I think of a lot of product leaders more like bands putting out albums.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_1

evidence.quote: And when they start thinking from first principles and with the taste that Adam, who was also on the pod, has, that product is well architected from a human computer interaction standpoint in a way that I think is actually really admirable on many levels.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_1

evidence.quote: It actually reminds me, there's so much talk these days about taste, and things like that, and so hard to describe things like that.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_1

evidence.quote: And I think if one way you can get at somebody's taste is when you're interviewing them is just ask them about some of the things they built that they never shipped.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_1

evidence.quote: And if they have a lot of high quality ideas that are on the shelf, exercising that muscle of saying no, of restraint, is probably one of the easiest... One of the few muscles of taste you can exercise.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_1

evidence.quote: And so, it's so interesting how this connects now to the... We talk about taste all the time with AI, and this is an interesting element of that, of being good at understanding what to remove as AI becomes a bigger part of the building process and designing process.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_0

evidence.quote: I think a lot of people who I look up to in terms of taste, and maybe it's just being in Los Angeles, but I care a lot about stuff like art, art behind me, stuff like that, is I've noticed that the difference, especially in wealthy people between those who have taste and those who are seen as gauche or something like that is, the ones with taste stop one step before everybody else does.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_1

evidence.quote: And so yeah, I don't know if that's super contrarian, but I think you can measure a lot is people with great taste seem to just know when to take something and get passionate about something and then kind of like-
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_1

entities.name: DAU/MAU
entities.how_described: 本集说 DAU/MAU 本质上就是次日留存，增长通常来自业务核心：把比率提高几个基点比拉新月活再赌留存更有效，Snap 和 Discord 都是例证。

evidence.quote: And so, that's why I think a lot of the most effective consumer products have extremely high DAU/MAU ratios.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_1

evidence.quote: And by the way, DAU/MAU is just a form of retention.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_1

entities.name: VCG
entities.how_described: 本集说现代广告拍卖本质是改进版的 Vickrey-Clarke-Groves 拍卖机制：把广告的自然价值计入出价，触达越不想被打扰的人广告主付越多，这一机制在聊天环境同样成立。

evidence.quote: And I do think that the mechanism, the mathematical mechanism, which is essentially a modified VCG, I think Vickrey-Clarke-Groves auction mechanism, this mathematical mechanism is the correct way to build an ads auction in even a chat environment, in ChatGPT.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_1

entities.name: 信任 (trust)
entities.how_described: 本集说在聊天广告里，用户该被广告主影响多少，应等于愿意拿多少信任来交换；信任最大化很可能与用户留存和广告主价值相关，Amazon 搜索第一条结果前十六条广告是反面教材。

evidence.quote: And the reason that I say that this is good for chat is not necessarily that organic value is what's important here, like how much you like an ad or not in a content feed, but in chat, it probably feels like this could be replaced or augmented with essentially trust.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_1

evidence.quote: And I think the mechanism by which how influenced I should be should essentially be how much trust I'm trading off.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_1

evidence.quote: It is getting a little crazy when you search for something and you have 16 ads before you get to the first thing, and you're like, "Oh shoot, is that subtly influencing my trust in the system?"
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_1

evidence.quote: And so, that's why I actually think OpenAI is speed running all the right stuff, and where the push is going to come to shove is how they instantiate it mathematically in their auction mechanism to maximize trust over the long term, because trust maximization will probably be correlated with user retention, if not causal, and with advertiser value.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_1
